page_title: VAL 0-1 RSO | Valencia v Real Sociedad 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
90+1' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad).
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

90' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Hernandez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Valencia using VAR. This could be interesting!
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Real Sociedad players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
89' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' Javi Guerra (Valencia) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
84' Fouls committed – 13:15.
81' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
79' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
78' Pepelu floats over the free kick into a crowded box. Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) does well to win the ball, but sends his header just over the bar from close in.
77' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul. Valencia win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
76' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
74' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) replacing Diego Lopez.
72' Kieran Tierney goes off the pitch and Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) comes on.
71' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' The attendance for today's match is 44200.
68' Alejandro Hernandez shows the yellow card to Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
68' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' 33:67 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
63' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
62' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) attempts to discuss the decision with Alejandro Hernandez, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
62' The foul by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benat Turrientes trots off the pitch and is replaced by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
61' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Jon Pacheco will be replaced by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
60' The game is interrupted. Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.

59' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
55' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Fran Perez and he is replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
55' Jose Gaya is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Gabriel Paulista (Valencia).
55' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) heads on.
53' Jose Gaya (Valencia) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
53' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) attempts to find Mohamed-Ali Cho, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
50' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Fran Perez (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad) comes off for Martin Zubimendi.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alvaro Odriozola comes on the pitch for Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad).
46' The game is over for Thierry Correia (Valencia). Cristhian Mosquera comes on for the second half.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Javi Guerra (Valencia) is booked.
45+2' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Alejandro Hernandez ignores the protests.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Selim Amallah (Valencia) will not be there to see the end of the game as he is shown a second yellow card instantly followed by red, and the game is over for him.
42' A yellow card for a tackle by Selim Amallah (Valencia). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
39' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
37' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
31' The ball possession at the moment is 40:60.
25' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) for a tough tackle.
25' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jose Gaya (Valencia).
23' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Hernandez signals a set piece.
21' Selim Amallah (Valencia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
20' Fran Perez (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Selim Amallah (Valencia) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro is prepared and dives to thwart him.
14' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
11' Javi Guerra (Valencia) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
9' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Valencia are awarded a free kick.
7' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
5' A pass from Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
4' Pepelu (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Alejandro Hernandez signals.
2' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Javi Guerra (Valencia) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Hernandez.
